nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at construction and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address proposed by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to 'SECR' in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 'SECURRO' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Public pure addition helper that requires c >= a to detect overflow.
Public pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a to detect underflow.
Public pure multiplication helper that validates a == 0 || c / a == b.
Public pure division helper that requires b > 0.
Constructor of Owned that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Only-owner function that stores a pending newOwner address.
Function that finalises ownership transfer when called by newOwner.
Token constructor that initialises metadata, total supply and the deployer balance.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to spender.
Spends an allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to'.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Approves spender and then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts any plain ETH transfer.
Only-owner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance updates.
Addition c = a + b whose overflow protection relies on a require comparison.
Subtraction c = a - b whose underflow protection relies on a require comparison.
Multiplication c = a * b whose overflow protection relies on a division check.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed inside totalSupply.
External call to spender.receiveApproval executed after the allowance write, enabling reentrancy.
External call to an arbitrary token contract transfer executed by the owner.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
msg.sender flows into the Owned constructor as the initial owner.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
SECURRO constructor assigns the symbol string.
SECURRO constructor assigns the name string.
SECURRO constructor assigns decimals.
SECURRO constructor assigns the total supply.
SECURRO constructor credits the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of the zero-address balance from the total supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner flows into balanceOf as the mapping key.
Parameter to flows into transfer as the recipient.
Parameter tokens flows into transfer as the amount.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
transfer rewrites balances using safeSub and safeAdd arithmetic.
Parameter spender flows into approve.
Parameter tokens flows into approve as the allowance value.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
Parameter from flows into transferFrom as the debited account.
Parameter to flows into transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter tokens flows into transferFrom as the amount.
msg.sender is the spender key of the allowance consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom rewrites balances using safeSub and safeAdd arithmetic.
transferFrom decreases the nested allowance mapping using safeSub.
Parameter tokenOwner flows into allowance as the outer mapping key.
Parameter spender flows into allowance as the inner mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter spender flows into approveAndCall as both allowance key and callee.
Parameter tokens flows into approveAndCall as the allowance value.
Parameter data flows into approveAndCall and is forwarded externally.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approveAndCall.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval after state updates.
Parameter tokenAddress flows into transferAnyERC20Token as the external callee.
Parameter tokens flows into transferAnyERC20Token as the rescue amount.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the destination of the rescued tokens.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner in transferAnyERC20Token.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract whose behaviour is untrusted.
Parameter a is used in the addition performed by safeAdd.
Parameter b is used in the addition performed by safeAdd.

safeSub performs the raw subtraction whose safety depends on a require assertion.
Parameter a is used in the multiplication performed by safeMul.
Parameter b is used in the multiplication performed by safeMul.

safeMul performs the raw multiplication whose safety depends on a division require assertion.
Parameter a is the dividend used in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor validated in safeDiv.
safeDiv stores the guarded division result in local c before returning it.
